description: The plot illustrates the loss ratio of different methods compared to a baseline with respect to computational cost. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and displays values on a linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with specific tick marks placed at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with a regular tick label interval of 1. Five methods are represented by solid lines. The "Vanilla" method is shown as a solid purple line without markers, remaining constant at a value of exactly 100 across the entire x-axis. The "SepLLM (n=64)" method is depicted by a solid red line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at 94 at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises sharply to a peak of approximately 99.5 at 3e8 TFLOPs, and gradually declines to end at roughly 98.5 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=128)" method is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 96.5 at 1e7 TFLOPs, increasing to a peak near 99.5 at 3e8 TFLOPs, and ending at about 99 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" method is illustrated by a solid green line with square markers, starting at roughly 97.5 at 1e7 TFLOPs, rising to a peak of about 99.8 at 3e8 TFLOPs, and finishing near 99.2 at 9e8 TFLOPs. Finally, the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" method is shown as a solid orange line with diamond markers, commencing at approximately 98.5 at 1e7 TFLOPs, reaching a peak of roughly 99.9 at 3e8 TFLOPs, and concluding at about 99.5 at 9e8 TFLOPs.
